componentSpecs.name: EmployeeRepository
componentSpecs.description: Implements IEmployeeRepository (extends IBaseRepository) using the pg pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts. All SQL queries use parameterized placeholders. The repository maps snake_case database columns to camelCase Employee interface fields via a private mapRow helper. All read queries filter out soft-deleted rows. The findActive method filters by both employment_status = ACTIVE AND deleted_at IS NULL. The delete method performs a soft delete. The update method appends updated_at = NOW() automatically and throws ValidationError when no fields are provided, or NotFoundError when the row does not exist.

componentSpecs.name: IEmployeeRepository
componentSpecs.description: Interface extending IBaseRepository<Employee> with four employee-specific query methods: findByEmployeeNumber (lookup by unique employee number), findByEmail (lookup by unique email), findByManagerId (list direct reports for a manager), and findActive (list all employees with employmentStatus = ACTIVE and not soft-deleted). All methods return promises and follow the repository pattern mandated by GP-001.

componentSpecs.name: EmployeeRepositoryUnitTests
componentSpecs.description: Jest unit tests for EmployeeRepository in tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.repository.spec.ts. Uses a mocked pg pool (jest.mock on src/shared/db/connection). Covers findById (found, not found, soft-delete exclusion), findByEmployeeNumber (found, not found), findByEmail (found, not found), create (insert and return), and update (success, no-fields error). Uses helper factories makeEmployee and makeRow to construct test data and expected database row shapes.
